resources.label: Presentation Prompt — Without the Skill
resources.instruction: Go back to the chat where you answered the 5 mission questions. For this first run stay in that chat — every finding your Minion uncovered is already there. Run this and keep the result.
resources.content: Build a presentation for Gru covering everything we found today.
resources.note: Notice what it did NOT do. It never asked who is in the room, what you want Gru to decide, or what tone fits. It just started building.

resources.label: Presentation Builder Skill
resources.description: A Skill that makes Claude interview you first with a short multiple-choice brief, then build a properly designed deck and hand it back as a PowerPoint file. Works in any Project, on any topic.

resources.label: Package Up Your Findings
resources.instruction: Still in your Level 02 chat. Before you go anywhere, ask your Minion to package up everything you found so you can carry it across.
resources.content:
Before we move to a new chat, package up everything we worked out today so I can carry it over. This brief is all the new chat will know, so do not compress it into headlines.

For each of the five mission questions, give me the answer, the specific number or percentage behind it, and the one line of reasoning that makes it convincing.

Then our special tool: what it is, what it does, and the risk it removes.

Finish with the two or three most surprising things the data told us.

Plain text, no preamble. Take the space you need — completeness matters more than brevity.

resources.label: Presentation Prompt — With the Skill
resources.instruction: Now start a new chat inside the same Project. Paste your mission brief where marked, then send. Your Minion has the same facts it had a moment ago — the only thing that changed is the Skill.
resources.content:
[PASTE YOUR MISSION BRIEF HERE]

Build a presentation for Gru covering everything above.
resources.note: It stops and asks five questions instead of building. Answer with just the letters — you can pick several where it says so. Then watch it build something shaped by your answers instead of its own guess.
